description: Add a custom domain to a Telbase app or project. Returns the DNS record to add (for an app registered with telbase apps create: one CNAME to cname.telbase.ai, for Vercel and Cloud Run alike; Telbase serves the domain and issues and renews its certificate), the detected DNS provider name (via NS lookup), and hostTrust: if the app lists the hosts or origins it trusts, add the domain there and redeploy. After DNS is configured, use verify_custom_domain to complete setup. If the user doesn't control DNS, offer to draft an IT request email they can forward, with the DNS record details. Custom domains require Starter plan or above. Not yet supported for multi-service projects (monorepos).

a_records.description: A Vercel app's root domain (acme.com) with A records, for DNS providers that cannot put a CNAME at the root. Vercel serves it directly, so sign-in, suspension and usage counting stay on the Telbase URL.

name: add_custom_domain
